text:
maya-cs: quick sync on PrivConnect rollout for Halogen Labs — a few blockers on network + audit logs
ryan-sre: I pulled their ingestion logs. We see delivery to s3://redwood-halogen-audit but CloudTrail data-events are NOT enabled for that bucket so nothing shows up in their SIEM
maya-cs: @lauren-customer can you confirm whether your infra team enabled data events for that bucket? that's the usual culprit
lauren-customer: pinged infra, they're looking. also security asked about KMS rotation: we proposed 90d but they'd like 30d — is that supported without extra ops burden?
kenji: 30d is supported, but it raises request volume to the CMK during decrypts. two options: shorten rotation and add caching at their side, or keep 90d and add attestation to satisfy auditors
sam: snippet of the cross-account role we usually send to customers:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodIngest"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}
  ]
}
```
maya-cs: thanks @sam — I'll share that. also note: their SIEM team uses syslog-ng pulling from our forwarder. we need to confirm TLS certs and port 6514 open on their firewall (they currently allow 514/tcp only)
ryan-sre: confirmed from our side: forwarder is sending TLS on 6514. If they must stick to 514 we can temporarily enable non-TLS fallback but request a security exception routed to security@halogen.io
lauren-customer: infra says opening 6514 requires a change window next week. can we queue a delayed cutover?
maya-cs: yes — propose cutover Wed 09:00 PT. I'll book the enablement session with runbook + smoke tests.
kenji: runbook checklist: 1) confirm CloudTrail data events enabled 2) confirm cross-account KMS policy applied 3) validate S3 bucket encryption and lifecycle 4) validate firewall egress for 6514 TLS 5) smoke: ingest 10 sample events and verify in SIEM
sam: adding one more — retention mismatch: they asked for 365d in SIEM but platform default is 90d for raw audit artifacts. need customer signoff to change retention and estimate storage costs
maya-cs: flagged as action item: get signed retention change + SOC2 evidence ETA. If they can't provide SOC2 docs within 30 days mark renewal risk = elevated
lauren-customer: SOC2 vendor report is with procurement; I expect we can get it in ~2 weeks. I'll escalate.
ops-bot: DeployCheck: forwarding-runner v3.4.1 -> healthy, last-forward 6876543205
maya-cs: great — summary of next steps:
- lauren: confirm data-events and firewall change window (by EOD)
- maya-cs: book Wed 09:00 PT enablement + send KMS role snippet
- kenji/ryan: prepare runbook and a temporary non-TLS fallback plan in case of emergency
- sam: estimate storage delta for 365d retention and share numbers
We'll reconvene in this thread after infra confirms. :thumbsup:
